items.title: Spot BTC ETFs log ~$2.4B week; Friday still +$134.5m
items.take: Seven-session inflow streak ~$3B; Farside Fri 25 Sep +$134.5m (revised vs earlier cooler print). YTD flows back green.
items.why_matters: Flow channel: institutional spot demand still constructive into the weekend even as daily pace cooled from the Sep 21 ~$1B spike.

items.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $84k after $87k weekly high
items.take: BTC near ~$84k Sat/Sun after ~4% pullback from ~$87.3k eight-month high; CheckOnChain still Spot Rally (7d OI −5.9%, px +3.7%).
items.why_matters: Price digesting with OI down → spot-led bounce, not fresh leverage — fits Mean reverting structure.

items.title: 10Y Treasury stays elevated above 5% into weekend
items.take: U.S. 10Y still >5.1% (Treasury XML 5.17% as of Sep 25); strong data + hike odds keep opportunity cost high vs crypto.
items.why_matters: Macro tension: weekly Fed net still Expanding at $5.7999T while yields stay tight — key confluence watch.

items.title: US spot Solana ETFs print record daily inflow (~$80–87m)
items.take: SOL ETFs ~$86.7m Fri record / ~$188m week; Bitwise BSOL led. Aligns with RSDH SOL 95% satellite peak display.
items.why_matters: Satellite risk: SOL-heavy RSDH stays elevated while BTC tape digests — alt ETF bid is a real flow, not invented.

items.title: PCE (Sep 30) next macro checkpoint after Sep 16 hike
items.take: Aug PCE due Wed Sep 30; Fed already at 3.75–4.00% after Sep 16 +25 bp. CME FedWatch page still not parseable this run.
items.why_matters: Policy path: inflation print can reprice Oct FOMC odds and keep risk premia firm into Q4.
